children.text: Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra, Prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra</s>, First Chapter

children.text: uḍḍīśena samākīrṇā yogivṛndasamākulā /
children.translated_text: Filled with [the teachings] proclaimed by <s>Uḍḍīśa</s>, thronged with multitudes of <s>yogins</s>,

children.text: praṇamya śirasā devī gaurī pṛcchati śaṃkaram // UT_1.1
children.translated_text: bowing her head, the goddess <s>Gaurī</s> asks <s>Śaṃkara</s>:

children.text: īśvara śrotum icchāmi lokanātha jagatprabho /
children.translated_text: O <s>Īśvara</s>, I wish to hear, O Lord of the World, O Master of the Universe,

children.text: prasādaṃ kuru deveśa brūhi dharmārthasādhakam // UT_1.2
children.translated_text: bestow your grace, O Lord of Gods, and tell me that which accomplishes <s>dharma</s> (righteous duty) and <s>artha</s> (worldly aims).

children.text: vaśīkaraṇam uccāṭaṃ mohanaṃ stambhanaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Vaśīkaraṇa</s> (subjugation), <s>uccāṭana</s> (eradication), <s>mohana</s> (bewilderment), <s>stambhana</s> (immobilization), and also

children.text: śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vātha karaṇāni bahūni ca // UT_1.3
children.translated_text: <s>śāntika</s> (pacification), <s>pauṣṭika</s> (nourishment), and many other rites;

children.text: cakṣurhāniṃ maheśāna śrutihāniṃ tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: destruction of sight, O <s>Maheśāna</s>, and likewise destruction of hearing,

children.text: jñānahāniṃ kriyāhāniṃ kīlakaṃ ca tathāparam // UT_1.4
children.translated_text: destruction of knowledge, destruction of action, and also <s>kīlaka</s> (pinning/locking);

children.text: kāryastambhaṃ sureśāna śoṣaṇaṃ pūraṇaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: immobilization of activities, O Lord of Gods, <s>śoṣaṇa</s> (desiccation) and <s>pūraṇa</s> (flooding) as well,

children.text: mantradhyānaṃ viśeṣeṇa tat sarvaṃ vada me prabho // UT_1.5
children.translated_text: and especially <s>mantra</s>-meditation -- tell me all of this, O Lord.

children.text: anyac ca vividhaṃ kāryaṃ prasādād brūhi bhairava /
children.translated_text: And also the various other practices, by your grace tell me, O <s>Bhairava</s>,

children.text: yasya vijñānamātreṇa manuṣyo bhuvi durlabhaḥ // UT_1.6
children.translated_text: by the mere knowledge of which a person becomes rare upon the earth.

children.text: śrīr īśvara uvāca /
children.translated_text: The blessed Lord spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu tvaṃ hi varārohe siddhyarthaṃ yadi pṛcchasi /
children.translated_text: Listen, O beautiful-hipped one, if you ask for the sake of <s>siddhi</s> (accomplishment),

children.text: tadvad iṣyāmi te devi tat sarvaṃ samudāhṛtam // UT_1.7
children.translated_text: then I shall proclaim to you, O <s>Devī</s>, all of that fully declared.

children.text: auṣadhair mantrajāpaiś ca ripuṃ hanyān na saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Through herbs and <s>mantra</s>-recitation one may slay an enemy, without doubt;

children.text: uḍḍīśāt sāram ākṛṣya mayoktaṃ tava bhaktitaḥ // UT_1.8
children.translated_text: having extracted the essence from the <s>Uḍḍīśa</s> [teachings], I have spoken it out of devotion to you.

children.text: uḍḍīśaṃ ca namaskṛtya rudraṃ caiva sudurlabham /
children.translated_text: Having paid homage to <s>Uḍḍīśa</s> and to <s>Rudra</s>, who is exceedingly rare [to attain],

children.text: kapardinaṃ virūpākṣaṃ sarvabhūtabhayāpaham // UT_1.9
children.translated_text: the matted-haired one, <s>Virūpākṣa</s>, the remover of fear of all beings,

children.text: vakṣye rudrodbhavān yogān sarvaśatruvināśakān /
children.translated_text: I shall declare the <s>yogas</s> (practices) born from <s>Rudra</s>, destroyers of all enemies;

children.text: tais tu prayojitaiḥ saḥ prāṇān hanti na saṃśayaḥ // UT_1.10
children.translated_text: when these are employed, they certainly destroy the life-breath -- there is no doubt.

children.text: prathamaṃ bhūtakaraṇaṃ dvitīyonmādanaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: The first is <s>bhūtakaraṇa</s> (spirit-affliction), the second is <s>unmādana</s> (maddening),

children.text: tṛtīyaṃ dveṣaṇaṃ cātha turyam uccāṭanaṃ tathā // UT_1.11
children.translated_text: the third is <s>dveṣaṇa</s> (creating enmity), and the fourth is <s>uccāṭana</s> (eradication);

children.text: grāmoccāṭaṃ pañcamaṃ ca jalastambhaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhakam /
children.translated_text: the fifth is <s>grāmoccāṭa</s> (village-eradication), the sixth is <s>jalastambha</s> (water-immobilization),

children.text: vahneḥ stambhakaraṃ cātha vaśīkaraṇam uttamam // UT_1.12
children.translated_text: and then <s>vahnistambhakara</s> (fire-immobilization), and the supreme <s>vaśīkaraṇa</s> (subjugation).

children.text: anyān api prayogāṃś ca bahūn śṛṇu varānane /
children.translated_text: Hear also of many other applications, O beautiful-faced one;

children.text: śivena kathitā yogā uḍḍīśe śāstraniścaye // UT_1.13
children.translated_text: these <s>yogas</s> (practices) were declared by <s>Śiva</s> in the <s>Uḍḍīśa</s>, the authoritative scripture.

children.text: andhīkaraṇaṃ mūkīkaraṇaṃ badhirīkaraṇaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Andhīkaraṇa</s> (blinding), <s>mūkīkaraṇa</s> (making mute), <s>badhirīkaraṇa</s> (making deaf), and also

children.text: bhūtajvarasya karaṇam astraśastrasya dūṣaṇam // UT_1.14
children.translated_text: the causing of <s>bhūtajvara</s> (spirit-fever), and the nullification of weapons and arms;

children.text: jaladoṣapraśamanaṃ dadhno madhuvināśanam /
children.translated_text: the calming of water-afflictions, the destruction of curds and honey,

children.text: vināśaṃ mattakaraṇaṃ gajavājiprakopanam // UT_1.15
children.translated_text: destruction, intoxication, and the enraging of elephants and horses;

children.text: ākarṣaṇaṃ bhujaṃgānāṃ mānavānāṃ tathā dhruvam /
children.translated_text: the attraction of serpents and likewise certainly of human beings,

children.text: vahner vināśanaṃ kuryāt parṇānāṃ hi vināśanam // UT_1.16
children.translated_text: one may accomplish the extinguishing of fire and the destruction of leaves;

children.text: gardabhasyātmakaraṇaṃ parakāyapraveśanam /
children.translated_text: transformation into a donkey, entering another's body,

children.text: vetālapādukāsiddhim ulvakāj jvalanaṃ tathā // UT_1.17
children.translated_text: <s>vetālapādukāsiddhi</s> (attainment of the vampire's sandals), and also burning from the caul;

children.text: anyān bahuprayogāṃś ca raudrān romapraharṣaṇān /
children.translated_text: and many other terrifying applications that make the hair stand on end,

children.text: vidyāmantraprayogādīn auṣadhāṃś cābhicārikān // UT_1.18
children.translated_text: <s>vidyā</s>-and-<s>mantra</s> applications and herbs used for <s>abhicāra</s> (sorcery) --

children.text: guptāguptatarāḥ kāryā rakṣitavyāḥ prayatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: these are to be kept secret and most secret, to be guarded with great care;

children.text: uḍḍīśaṃ yo na jānāti sa ruṣṭaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati // UT_1.19
children.translated_text: he who does not know the <s>Uḍḍīśa</s>, even if angered, what can he do?

children.text: sumeruṃ cālayet sthānāt sāgaraiḥ plāvayen mahīm /
children.translated_text: One could move <s>Sumeru</s> from its place, flood the earth with oceans,

children.text: sūryaṃ ca pātayed bhūmau nedaṃ mithyā bhaviṣyati // UT_1.20
children.translated_text: and cast the sun down to the ground -- this shall not prove false.

children.text: yathaivendrasya vajraṃ ca pāśaṃ hi varuṇasya ca /
children.translated_text: Just as <s>Indra</s>'s thunderbolt and <s>Varuṇa</s>'s noose,

children.text: yamasya ca yathā daṇḍaṃ kuberasya gadā yathā // UT_1.21
children.translated_text: and <s>Yama</s>'s staff, and <s>Kubera</s>'s mace,

children.text: vahneḥ śaktir yathā proktā khaḍgas tu nirṛter yathā /
children.translated_text: and <s>Agni</s>'s spear as declared, and the sword of <s>Nirṛti</s>,

children.text: yathā vāyoś cāṅkuśaṃ hi triśūlaṃ śūlapāṇinaḥ // UT_1.22
children.translated_text: and <s>Vāyu</s>'s goad, and the trident of the Trident-bearer [<s>Śiva</s>],

children.text: skandasya ca yathā śaktir viṣṇoś cakraṃ sudarśanam /
children.translated_text: and <s>Skanda</s>'s lance, and <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s discus <s>Sudarśana</s> --

children.text: tathaite ca mahāyogāḥ prayuktāḥ śatrukāraṇe // UT_1.23
children.translated_text: even so are these great <s>yogas</s> (practices) when employed against enemies.

children.text: anivṛtte nivartante amoghā nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: When [the target] does not retreat, they turn him back; they are infallible -- there is no doubt herein;

children.text: saṃtuṣṭena prayuktena sidhyanti suvicārataḥ // UT_1.24
children.translated_text: when employed by one who is content and with proper deliberation, they succeed.

children.text: ratānāṃ karaṇaṃ vakṣye śatrusādhanam uttamam /
children.translated_text: I shall now describe the rite of <s>rata</s> (night-spirits), the supreme means of subduing enemies,

children.text: yenaiva kṛtamātreṇa bhūto gṛhṇāti mānavam // UT_1.25
children.translated_text: by the mere performance of which a <s>bhūta</s> (spirit) seizes a person.

children.text: nimbakāṣṭhaṃ samādāya caturaṅgulamānataḥ /
children.translated_text: Taking a piece of <s>nimba</s> (neem) wood, four fingers in length,

children.text: śatruviṣṭāsamāliptaṃ tathā nāma samālikhet // UT_1.26
children.translated_text: smeared with the enemy's excrement, one should inscribe [the enemy's] name upon it.

children.text: citāṅgāreṇa tannāmnā dhūpaṃ dadyān maheśvari /
children.translated_text: With a cremation-ground ember, using that name, one should offer incense, O <s>Maheśvarī</s>;

children.text: citāntaḥ saṃsthito bhūtvā yasya gātramṛdāharet // UT_1.27
children.translated_text: standing within the cremation ground, one should take away the body-clay of the target.

children.text: kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyām aṣṭottaraśataṃ japet /
children.translated_text: On the dark eighth or fourteenth [lunar day], one should recite one hundred and eight times;

children.text: bhūto gṛhṇāti taṃ śīghraṃ mantreṇānena mantritaḥ // UT_1.28
children.translated_text: a <s>bhūta</s> (spirit) seizes that person swiftly, empowered by this <s>mantra</s>:

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate sarvabhūtādhipataye virūpākṣāya nityaṃ krūrāya daṃṣṭriṇe vikarāline grahayakṣabhūtavetālena saha śaṃkara manuṣyaṃ daha daha paca paca gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gṛhṇāpaya gṛhṇāpaya huṃ phaṭ svāhā /
children.translated_text: uoṃ namo bhagavate sarvabhūtādhipataye virūpākṣāya nityaṃ krūrāya daṃṣṭriṇe vikarāline grahayakṣabhūtavetālena saha śaṃkara manuṣyaṃ daha daha (burn, burn) paca paca (cook, cook) gṛhṇa gṛhṇa (seize, seize) gṛhṇāpaya gṛhṇāpaya (cause to seize, cause to seize) huṃ phaṭ svāhā

children.text: pratyānayaṃ yadīccheta tasyaiṣā kriyate kriyā /
children.translated_text: If one desires to bring about a reversal [of the affliction], this procedure is performed:

children.text: dāpayed devam īśānaṃ ghṛtena vacayā saha // UT_1.29
children.translated_text: one should make an offering to the god <s>Īśāna</s> with ghee together with <s>vacā</s> (calamus).

children.text: guggulaṃ pradaded dhūpaṃ ghṛtamiśraṃ samantataḥ /
children.translated_text: One should offer <s>guggula</s> (bdellium) incense mixed with ghee all around;

children.text: mantreṇa mantrayitvā tu tataḥ svāsthyaṃ bhavet kila // UT_1.30
children.translated_text: having consecrated it with the <s>mantra</s>, then health shall be restored indeed.

children.text: mantraḥ uoṃ namaḥ śivāya śāntāya prabhāya muktāya devādhidevāya śubhrabāhave vyādhiṃ śamaya śamaya amukaḥ svastho bhavatu namo 'stu te /
children.translated_text: The <s>mantra</s>: uoṃ namaḥ śivāya śāntāya prabhāya muktāya devādhidevāya śubhrabāhave vyādhiṃ śamaya śamaya (pacify the disease, pacify) amukaḥ svastho bhavatu (may so-and-so be well) namo 'stu te

children.text: iti svāsthyamantraḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus is the health-restoring <s>mantra</s>.

children.text: athānyat sampravakṣyāmi prayogaṃ bhuvi durlabham /
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare another application, rare upon the earth,

children.text: yenaiva kṛtamātreṇa jvaro gṛhṇāti mānavam // UT_1.31
children.translated_text: by the mere performance of which fever seizes a person.

children.text: nimbakāṣṭhākṛtiṃ kṛtvā caturaṅgulamānataḥ /
children.translated_text: Making a figure from <s>nimba</s> (neem) wood, four fingers in length,

children.text: tasyā hṛdi viṣonmattarājikālavaṇais tathā // UT_1.32
children.translated_text: upon its heart [one should place] <s>viṣa</s> (poison), <s>unmattarājikā</s> (wild mustard), and salt;

children.text: nāma saṃlikhya prakṛtau pācyamānāyāṃ tataḥ param /
children.translated_text: having inscribed the name upon the effigy while it is being heated,

children.text: tatas tu śatrunāmnā ca aṣṭottaraśataṃ japet // UT_1.33
children.translated_text: then, using the enemy's name, one should recite one hundred and eight times.

children.text: tataḥ sa praharārdhena jvarabhūtena gṛhyate /
children.translated_text: Then within half a <s>prahara</s> (approximately one and a half hours), [the enemy] is seized by a fever-spirit.

children.text: atha japamantraḥ uoṃ bakāmukhā cāmuṇḍā amukasya kṣīramāṃsaśoṇitabhojinī amukaṃ khaḥ khaḥ jvareṇa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gṛhṇāpaya gṛhṇāpaya huṃ phaṭ svāhā /
children.translated_text: Now the recitation-<s>mantra</s>: uoṃ bakāmukhā cāmuṇḍā amukasya (of so-and-so) kṣīramāṃsaśoṇitabhojinī (devourer of milk, flesh, and blood) amukaṃ khaḥ khaḥ jvareṇa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa (seize with fever, seize) gṛhṇāpaya gṛhṇāpaya (cause to seize, cause to seize) huṃ phaṭ svāhā

children.text: pratyānayaṃ yadīccheta tasyaiṣā kriyate kriyā // UT_1.34
children.translated_text: If one desires to bring about a reversal [of the affliction], this procedure is performed.

children.text: dugdhasnātanāmākṣarāṇi tadā svastho bhaved iti /
children.translated_text: The syllables of the name, bathed in milk -- then health shall be restored.

children.text: athānyat sampravakṣyāmi prayogaṃ bhuvi durlabham // UT_1.35
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare another application, rare upon the earth,

children.text: yena vijñānamātreṇa śatror uccāṭanaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: by the mere performance of which the <s>uccāṭana</s> (eradication) of the enemy occurs.

children.text: brahmadaṇḍī citābhasma gomayasya tathaiva ca // UT_1.36
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmadaṇḍī</s> (a plant, Argemone mexicana), cremation-ground ash, and cow dung as well,

children.text: kṣāraṃ cāpi samādāya kākajaṅgāsamanvitam /
children.translated_text: and also alkali, combined with <s>kākajaṅgā</s> (a poisonous plant) --

children.text: kṣipec chirasi śatrūṇāṃ tūrṇam uccāṭayed ripum // UT_1.37
children.translated_text: one should throw [this] on the heads of enemies; it quickly eradicates the foe.

children.text: tataḥ saṃsnāpayed enaṃ gokṣīreṇa samanvitam /
children.translated_text: Then one should bathe him with cow's milk;

children.text: muṇḍanaṃ cātha keśānāṃ tataḥ svastho bhaved dhruvam // UT_1.38
children.translated_text: and then shaving of the hair -- thereafter health shall certainly be restored.

children.text: athānyat sampravakṣyāmi śatror uccāṭanaṃ varam /
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare another excellent <s>uccāṭana</s> (eradication) [rite] against enemies,

children.text: dhūpaṃ nirbhedakaṃ nāma svayaṃ rudreṇa bhāṣitam // UT_1.39
children.translated_text: an incense called <s>Nirbhedaka</s> (the Piercing), declared by <s>Rudra</s> himself.

children.text: brahmadaṇḍī samūlā ca kākajaṅgā samanvitā /
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmadaṇḍī</s> with its root, combined with <s>kākajaṅgā</s>,

children.text: nirmokaṃ sarparājasya dhūpam uccāṭayed ripūn // UT_1.40
children.translated_text: and the sloughed skin of the king of serpents -- [used as] incense, it eradicates enemies.

children.text: sarpakañcukam ādāya kṛṣṇoragaśiras tathā /
children.translated_text: Taking a snake's shed skin and the head of a black serpent,

children.text: nikhaned yasya ca dvāre tam uccāṭayate haṭhāt // UT_1.41
children.translated_text: one should bury [them] at the doorway of [the target] -- it eradicates him by force.

children.text: brahmadaṇḍī surāmāṃsī kacchapasya śiras tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmadaṇḍī</s>, <s>surāmāṃsī</s> (a type of spikenard), and the head of a tortoise,

children.text: śmaśānabhasmasaṃyuktaṃ kapāle mānuṣe nyaset // UT_1.42
children.translated_text: combined with cremation-ground ash, one should place [them] in a human skull.

children.text: śatror dvāre nikhātena tūrṇam uccāṭayed ripūn /
children.translated_text: Buried at the enemy's doorway, it quickly eradicates enemies;

children.text: saptarātrau deveśi samūlaṃ naśyate gṛham // UT_1.43
children.translated_text: within seven nights, O Queen of Gods, the household is destroyed from its root.

children.text: atha vidveṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śatrūṇāṃ śṛṇu śaṃkari /
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare <s>vidveṣaṇa</s> (creating enmity); listen, O <s>Śaṃkarī</s>,

children.text: yenaiva kṛtamātreṇa vidveṣo jāyate nṛṇām // UT_1.44
children.translated_text: by the mere performance of which enmity arises among people.

children.text: brahmadaṇḍī samūlā ca kākamāṃsena saṃyutā /
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmadaṇḍī</s> with its root, combined with crow's flesh,

children.text: jātīpuṣparasair bhāvyā saptarātraṃ punaḥ punaḥ // UT_1.45
children.translated_text: should be steeped in <s>jātī</s> (jasmine) flower juice for seven nights, again and again.

children.text: tato mārjāramūtreṇa saptāhaṃ bhāvayet tataḥ /
children.translated_text: Then with cat's urine one should steep it for seven days;

children.text: eṣa dhūpaḥ pradātavyaḥ śatrugotrasya madhyataḥ // UT_1.46
children.translated_text: this incense should be administered in the midst of the enemy's clan.

children.text: yathā gandhaṃ samāghrāti pitā putraiḥ samaṃ kaliḥ /
children.translated_text: As soon as they smell the odor, quarrel [arises] between father and sons;

children.text: vidveṣaṇaṃ paraṃ teṣāṃ suhṛdbhir bāndhavaiḥ saha // UT_1.47
children.translated_text: this is the supreme <s>vidveṣaṇa</s> (enmity-creation) for them, together with friends and relatives.

children.text: svasthīkaraṇakaṃ proktaṃ ghṛtagugguladhūpataḥ /
children.translated_text: The restoration to health is accomplished through incense of ghee and <s>guggula</s> (bdellium).

children.text: atha māraṇam /
children.translated_text: Now, <s>māraṇa</s> (death-rite):

children.text: surāṃ mānuṣamāṃsaṃ ca samādāya vicakṣaṇaḥ // UT_1.48
children.translated_text: a skilled practitioner, taking liquor and human flesh,

children.text: gṛdhrāsthi śatruviṣṭhāṃ ca dvāramadhye nikhātayet /
children.translated_text: and vulture bones and the enemy's excrement, should bury [them] in the middle of a doorway;

children.text: saptāhena bhaven māro yathā rudreṇa bhāṣitam // UT_1.49
children.translated_text: within seven days death occurs, as declared by <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: brahmadaṇḍī citābhasma surāmāṃsīsamāyutam /
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmadaṇḍī</s>, cremation-ground ash, combined with <s>surāmāṃsī</s> (spikenard),

children.text: ariṣṭasya ca pattrāṇi viṣaṃ rudhiram eva ca // UT_1.50
children.translated_text: and leaves of <s>ariṣṭa</s> (soapberry tree), poison, and blood --

children.text: mohāya ca prayoktavyaḥ śatrūṇāṃ nāmayogataḥ /
children.translated_text: these should be employed for <s>mohana</s> (bewilderment) of enemies, using the name-formula;

children.text: saptarātraprayogena sarvaśatrupraṇāśanam // UT_1.51
children.translated_text: through the application over seven nights, all enemies are destroyed.

children.text: eteṣāṃ duṣṭayogānāṃ śatrave tad udāhṛtam /
children.translated_text: For these malefic practices directed against enemies, as declared,

children.text: śatam aṣṭottareṇaiva mantrayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ // UT_1.52
children.translated_text: the skilled practitioner should consecrate [them] with one hundred and eight [recitations of the <s>mantra</s>]:

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate śrīuḍḍāmareśvarāya amukam uccāṭaya uccāṭaya vidveṣaya vidveṣaya svāhā /
children.translated_text: uoṃ namo bhagavate śrī-<s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>āya amukaṃ (so-and-so) uccāṭaya uccāṭaya (eradicate, eradicate) vidveṣaya vidveṣaya (create enmity, create enmity) svāhā

children.text: ekarātroṣito bhūtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having fasted for one night, on the dark eighth [lunar day], with concentrated mind,

children.text: devam abhyarcya ceśānaṃ śatam aṣṭādhikaṃ japet // UT_1.53
children.translated_text: having worshipped the god <s>Īśāna</s>, one should recite one hundred and eight times.

children.text: mantram etat prayoktavyaṃ siddhaye siddhikāmyayā /
children.translated_text: This <s>mantra</s> should be employed for <s>siddhi</s> (success), by one who desires accomplishment;

children.text: śatrusainye prayoktavyaṃ rājñaś ca vijayārthinaḥ // UT_1.54
children.translated_text: it should be employed against the army of an enemy, and for a king seeking victory.

children.text: lāṅgūlaṃ gṛhagodhāyāḥ kṛkalāsasya mastakam /
children.translated_text: The tail of a house-lizard, the head of a chameleon,

children.text: indragopakasaṃyuktaṃ jambūkasya śiras tathā // UT_1.55
children.translated_text: combined with <s>indragopaka</s> (cochineal insects), and the head of a jackal --

children.text: etāni samabhāgāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet /
children.translated_text: these should be made into fine powder in equal parts;

children.text: amukte hi prayoktavyaṃ sarvaṃ janaśataṃ haret // UT_1.56
children.translated_text: when applied without [the target's] knowledge, it destroys an entire hundred people.

children.text: nṛkapālaṃ samūtraṃ ca pecakasya śiras tathā /
children.translated_text: A human skull with urine, and the head of an owl,

children.text: vṛścikasya tu lāṅgūlaṃ hālāhalakam eva ca // UT_1.57
children.translated_text: and the tail of a scorpion, and <s>hālāhala</s> (deadly poison),

children.text: śvetamaṇḍūkamāṃsaṃ ca mūtraṃ caiva gajoṣṭrayoḥ /
children.translated_text: and the flesh of a white frog, and the urine of elephant and camel --

children.text: gṛhītvā samabhāgāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet // UT_1.58
children.translated_text: taking these in equal parts, one should make them into fine powder.

children.text: etāni śoṣayitvā tu kalkaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having dried these and making a paste again and again,

children.text: uoṃ hīṃ yamāya śatrunāśanāya svāhā /
children.translated_text: uoṃ hīṃ yamāya śatrunāśanāya (for the destruction of enemies) svāhā

children.text: anne pāne pradātavyaṃ ripusainyavināśanam // UT_1.59
children.translated_text: [it should be] administered in food or drink -- it destroys the enemy's army.

children.text: spṛṣṭamātreṇa tenaiva visphoṭās tu samantataḥ /
children.translated_text: By mere touch of that [substance], boils [break out] all over;

children.text: tasya dehe jvaras tīvro bhavet tīvrā ca vedanā // UT_1.60
children.translated_text: in that person's body a fierce fever arises, and intense pain.

children.text: mriyate saptarātrau pratyānayanavarjitaḥ /
children.translated_text: He dies within seven nights, with no possibility of reversal.

children.text: athānyat sampravakṣyāmi yasya dhyānena sādhanam // UT_1.61
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare another [practice], accomplished through meditation,

children.text: kathitaṃ caiva rudreṇa tridaśebhyaḥ prasādataḥ /
children.translated_text: which was told by <s>Rudra</s> to the gods, by his grace.

children.text: rudhiraṃ kṛṣṇasarpasya kukkuṭasya tu kasyacit // UT_1.62
children.translated_text: The blood of a black serpent and of a certain rooster,

children.text: kacchapasya mayūrāṇāṃ rocanaṃ jātyañjanaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: of a tortoise and of peacocks, <s>rocanā</s> (yellow orpiment/gorocanā), <s>jātyañjana</s> (a type of collyrium),

children.text: kuṅkumaṃ bhadramustaṃ ca tagaraṃ kṛṣṇam eva ca // UT_1.63
children.translated_text: <s>kuṅkuma</s> (saffron), <s>bhadramustā</s> (a type of cyperus grass), and black <s>tagara</s> (valerian) --

children.text: etāni samabhāgāni puṣyārke ca samāharet /
children.translated_text: these should be collected in equal parts when the <s>Puṣya</s> [lunar asterism] falls on a Sunday,

children.text: aśleṣāyāṃ tu piṣṭāni kṛtvā pātre ca rājate // UT_1.64
children.translated_text: and ground on [a day of] <s>Āśleṣā</s> [lunar asterism], and placed in a silver vessel.

children.text: daśāhaṃ sthāpayed bhūmyāṃ paścād uddhṛtya lepayet /
children.translated_text: It should be kept underground for ten days; afterwards, having dug it up, one should apply it [as an ointment].

children.text: asidhārāṅgadā nāma svayaṃ rudreṇa bhāṣitā // UT_1.65
children.translated_text: This is called <s>Asidhārāṅgadā</s> (Sword-edge Ointment), declared by <s>Rudra</s> himself.

children.text: athālipet tu gātrāṇi sa kṛtvāsthīny athāpi vā /
children.translated_text: One should anoint the limbs, or having made it upon bones,

children.text: phalapuṣpe tathā pattre dhūpasattais tathaiva ca // UT_1.66
children.translated_text: or upon fruits, flowers, leaves, or upon incense-threads likewise --

children.text: agado 'yaṃ mahāmantro bhūtānāṃ ca bhayāvahaḥ /
children.translated_text: this is an antidote, a great <s>mantra</s>, terrifying to <s>bhūtas</s> (spirits);

children.text: anne pāne mantrayitvā prayuñjīta vidhānataḥ // UT_1.67
children.translated_text: having consecrated food and drink with the <s>mantra</s>, one should apply it according to the proper method.

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya śāntāya divyayogāya divyarūpāya jaṭilabrahmacāriṇe agadokṣitridaśaiva mahābalaśataṃ manohaṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā /
children.translated_text: uoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya śāntāya divyayogāya divyarūpāya jaṭilabrahmacāriṇe agadokṣitridaśaiva mahābalaśataṃ manohaṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā

children.text: pīḍyamānaṃ japen mantraṃ śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: When [someone is] afflicted, one should recite this <s>mantra</s>, having become pure and concentrated,

children.text: aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu tato mantram imaṃ japet // UT_1.68
children.translated_text: one thousand and eight times -- one should recite this <s>mantra</s>.

children.text: kanyayā peṣayac caiva goṣṭhamadhye prayatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: It should be ground by a maiden, in the midst of a cowpen, with great care;

children.text: tadaśaktau citāyāṃ tu yathāśakti punaḥ punaḥ // UT_1.69
children.translated_text: if unable [to do so there], then at a cremation ground, as much as possible, again and again.

children.text: svayaṃ rudreṇa samproktaṃ sarvakāryaprasādhakam /
children.translated_text: This was declared by <s>Rudra</s> himself, the accomplisher of all purposes;

children.text: sarve caiva prayoktavyāḥ sarvaśatruvināśakāḥ // UT_1.70
children.translated_text: all [these practices] should be employed -- they are destroyers of all enemies.

children.text: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena rakṣitavyāḥ prayogavān /
children.translated_text: Therefore, with every effort, the practitioner should guard [these teachings];

children.text: abhukte naiva prokta yaṃ krūre pāpajane tathā // UT_1.71
children.translated_text: they should not be told to one who has not [properly] eaten, nor to a cruel or sinful person.

children.text: dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktāya śāstrajñāyāmareśvari /
children.translated_text: They should be given to one endowed with devotion and knowledge of the scriptures, O <s>Amareśvarī</s>.

children.text: iti pārvatīśivasaṃvāde vīrabhadreśvaratantroddhṛte uḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ // UT_1.72
children.translated_text: Thus ends the first chapter in the great <s>Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra</s>, extracted from the <s>Vīrabhadreśvaratantra</s>, in the dialogue between <s>Pārvatī</s> and <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra, Dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra</s>, Second Chapter

children.text: athānyat sampravakṣyāmi jalastambhanam uttamam /
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare another [practice], the supreme <s>jalastambhana</s> (water-immobilization).

children.text: kumbhīravelvadaṃṣṭrāni rudhiraṃ māṃsam eva ca // UT_2.1
children.translated_text: The teeth of a crocodile and a type of aquatic creature, blood and flesh,

children.text: hṛdayaṃ kacchapasyaiva śiśumāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ /
children.translated_text: and the heart of a tortoise and [parts of] a <s>śiśumāra</s> (Gangetic dolphin), again and again,

children.text: vibhītakasya tailena sarvān ekatra kārayet // UT_2.2
children.translated_text: should all be combined together in <s>vibhītaka</s> (Terminalia bellirica) oil.

children.text: nyāsakarma tataḥ kṛtvā jale tiṣṭhed yathāsukham /
children.translated_text: Then having performed the <s>nyāsa</s> (ritual placement) rite, one may stand in water at ease.

children.text: madrakasya rasaṃ grāhyaṃ lakṣaṇasya makarasya ca // UT_2.3
children.translated_text: The juice of <s>madraka</s> should be taken, and of <s>lakṣaṇa</s> and of a <s>makara</s> (crocodile),

children.text: ḍuṇḍubhasya śiro grāhyaṃ sarvān ekatra kārayet /
children.translated_text: and the head of a <s>ḍuṇḍubha</s> (a type of snake) should be taken -- all should be combined together;

children.text: vibhītakasya taile tu pacyamāne ca dāpayet // UT_2.4
children.translated_text: these should be placed in <s>vibhītaka</s> oil while it is being heated.

children.text: nyāsakarma prakurvīta saptāhaṃ tiṣṭhate jale /
children.translated_text: One should perform the <s>nyāsa</s> (ritual placement) rite -- [then] one remains in water for seven days.

children.text: tat tailaṃ pācayet lauhe kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ // UT_2.5
children.translated_text: That oil should be cooked in an iron [vessel], on the dark eighth [lunar day], with concentrated mind;

children.text: caturmāsoṣito bhūtvā devam abhyarcya śaṃkaram /
children.translated_text: having fasted for four months, and having worshipped the god <s>Śaṃkara</s>,

children.text: abhimantrya ca mantreṇa mṛttikāsnānadakṣiṇam // UT_2.6
children.translated_text: having consecrated it with the <s>mantra</s>, [one should offer] clay, bathing [materials], and <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).

children.text: aṣṭādhikasahasraṃ tu japitvā homam ācaret /
children.translated_text: Having recited one thousand and eight times, one should perform the <s>homa</s> (fire-oblation);

children.text: anena mantrayitvā tu tataḥ sidhyati nānyathā // UT_2.7
children.translated_text: having consecrated [it] with this <s>mantra</s>, then it becomes effective -- not otherwise.

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate uḍḍāmareśvarāya jalaṃ stambhaya stambhaya huṃ phaṭ svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>! Arrest the water, arrest! <s>Huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>! /

children.text: vakṣye 'tha lūtākaraṇaṃ taṃ śṛṇuṣva samāsataḥ /
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe the procedure for causing <s>lūtā</s> (skin eruptions); hear it in brief /

children.text: bhallātakarasaṃ guñjā viṣaṃ citrakam eva ca // UT_2.8
children.translated_text: The juice of <s>bhallātaka</s> (marking nut), <s>guñjā</s> (rosary pea), poison, and <s>citraka</s> (leadwort) // UT_2.8

children.text: kapikacchaparomāṇi cūrṇāṃ kṛtvā pradāpayet /
children.translated_text: Having made a powder of <s>kapikacchu</s> (velvet bean) hairs, one should administer it /

children.text: etat sarvasamāyukto lūtākaraṇam uttamam // UT_2.9
children.translated_text: This, combined with all [the above ingredients], is the supreme method for causing <s>lūtā</s> (skin eruptions) // UT_2.9

children.text: tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi jāyate yas tu lakṣaṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: I shall describe the symptoms that arise with its characteristic signs /

children.text: aṅgāni dhūmam āyānti mūrchayanti muhur muhuḥ // UT_2.10
children.translated_text: The limbs give off smoke [become inflamed], and [the victim] faints repeatedly // UT_2.10

children.text: etad rūpaṃ bhavet tasya lūtāvikṛtalakṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: These are the symptoms of <s>lūtā</s> (skin eruption) disfigurement /

children.text: cikitsāṃ tasya vakṣyāmi yena sampadyate sukham // UT_2.11
children.translated_text: I shall describe the treatment by which comfort is restored // UT_2.11

children.text: uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva priyaṅgutagaraṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Uśīra</s> (vetiver), sandalwood, <s>priyaṅgu</s> (beauty-berry), and <s>tagara</s> (valerian) /

children.text: raktacandanakuṣṭhaṃ ca lepo lūtāvināśanaḥ // UT_2.12
children.translated_text: Red sandalwood and <s>kuṣṭha</s> (costus) — this paste destroys <s>lūtā</s> // UT_2.12

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate uḍḍāmareśvarāya kuhalīkurvanī svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>! O she who bewitches, <s>svāhā</s>! /

children.text: mantrābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ svastho bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: Having consecrated [the paste] with the <s>mantra</s>, thereby [the patient] will become well /

children.text: kṛṣṇasarpaśiro grāhyaṃ mukhe niḥkṣipya sarṣapān // UT_2.13
children.translated_text: One should take the head of a black serpent, and place mustard seeds in its mouth // UT_2.13

children.text: bhallātakena saṃyuktaṃ kṛṣṇasūtreṇa veṣṭayet /
children.translated_text: Combined with <s>bhallātaka</s> (marking nut), one should wrap it with a black thread /

children.text: valmīkasya mṛdaḥ kośe antardhūmena pācayet // UT_2.14
children.translated_text: In a vessel of anthill clay, one should cook it with smoke within // UT_2.14

children.text: kapikacchaparomāṇi saṃyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśakaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Combined with <s>kapikacchu</s> (velvet bean) hairs in sixteen parts /

children.text: viṣasya cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu śatrūṇāṃ mūrdhni niḥkṣipet // UT_2.15
children.translated_text: Having made a powder of the poison, one should cast it upon the heads of enemies // UT_2.15

children.text: śaradgrīṣmavasanteṣu lūtākaraṇam uttamam /
children.translated_text: In autumn, summer, and spring is the best [time] for causing <s>lūtā</s> (skin eruptions) /

children.text: prasvinne ca tato gātre lagnās tasmiṃs tu sarṣapāḥ // UT_2.16
children.translated_text: When the body is perspiring, the mustard seeds adhere to it // UT_2.16

children.text: lūtāṃ ca saviṣāṃ kuryān nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
children.translated_text: It produces poisonous <s>lūtā</s> — there should be no doubt about this /

children.text: vedanājātamātreṇa mantrajāpaṃ tu pūrvavat // UT_2.17
children.translated_text: As soon as pain arises, <s>mantra</s> recitation [should be performed] as before // UT_2.17

children.text: pūrvo vidhānena svastho bhavati pūrvavat /
children.translated_text: By the previous procedure, [the patient] becomes well as before /

children.text: atha śasyavināśaṃ ca kathayāmi samāsataḥ // UT_2.18
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe the destruction of crops in brief // UT_2.18

children.text: yenaiva kṛtamātreṇa vajraṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: By the mere performance of which, the skillful one, having made a thunderbolt /

children.text: kṣetre sampātayed yasmiṃs tasmiñ śasyavināśanam // UT_2.19
children.translated_text: Should cast it upon whichever field — in that [field], the crops are destroyed // UT_2.19

children.text: māhendreṇa kṣipet tatra prayogeṇa tu mantravit /
children.translated_text: One should cast it there with the <s>Māhendra</s> (of <s>Indra</s>) procedure, being a knower of <s>mantras</s> /

children.text: atha mantraṃ punar vakṣye prayogeṣu prayojakam // UT_2.20
children.translated_text: Now I shall again describe the <s>mantra</s> to be employed in practices // UT_2.20

children.text: aṣṭottaraśatenaiva mantreṇānena mantrayet /
children.translated_text: One should consecrate with this <s>mantra</s> one hundred and eight times /

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate uḍḍāmareśvarāya vajraṃ vināśaya vajraṃ surapatir ājñāpaya huṃ phaṭ svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>! Destroy the thunderbolt, destroy! May the lord of the gods command! <s>Huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>! /

children.text: imaṃ yogaṃ prayuñjāno vidhipūrveṇa karmaṇā /
children.translated_text: Employing this practice with the proper ritual procedure /

children.text: parṇānāṃ caiva yogena kṣipet parṇaṃ vinaśyati // UT_2.21
children.translated_text: By the combination with leaves, casting a leaf, it is destroyed // UT_2.21

children.text: punar uccāṭanaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu putra yathātathā /
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe the <s>uccāṭana</s> (eradication/banishment); hear, O son, exactly as it is /

children.text: yenaiva kṛtamātreṇa grāmasyoccāṭanaṃ bhavet // UT_2.22
children.translated_text: By the mere performance of which, the <s>uccāṭana</s> (banishment) of a village occurs // UT_2.22

children.text: grāme caturṇāṃ ca pathāṃ mṛdam ādāya buddhimān /
children.translated_text: The wise one should take earth from the four roads of the village /

children.text: gomayenākṛtiṃ kṛtvā grāmasya ca caturdiśaḥ // UT_2.23
children.translated_text: Having made a figure with cow dung, [placing it] in the four directions of the village // UT_2.23

children.text: citākāṣṭhānalaṃ kṛtvā kokilākākapakṣakaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Making a fire with cremation-ground wood, with feathers of cuckoos and crows /

children.text: hutvā cāhutisāhasraṃ tato bhasma samāharet // UT_2.24
children.translated_text: Having offered a thousand oblations, then one should collect the ashes // UT_2.24

children.text: abhedena samutsārya kṛtvā muṣṭiṃ sabhasmakam /
children.translated_text: Having scattered [the ashes] without distinction, making a fistful with ashes /

children.text: śatavārābhijaptena anenaiva tu mantritaḥ // UT_2.25
children.translated_text: Consecrated with this very [<s>mantra</s>] recited a hundred times // UT_2.25

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate mahākālarudrāya tripuravināśanakāraṇāya daha daha dhama dhama paca paca matha matha mohaya mohaya unmādaya unmādaya ucchedaya ucchedaya śrīmahārudra ājñāpayati śabdakarī mohinī bhagavatī kheṃ kheṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Mahākāla Rudra</s>, the cause of the destruction of the three cities! Burn, burn! Blaze, blaze! Cook, cook! Churn, churn! Delude, delude! Drive mad, drive mad! Uproot, uproot! The glorious <s>Mahārudra</s> commands! O <s>Śabdakarī</s>, <s>Mohinī</s>, O Goddess! <s>Kheṃ kheṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>! /

children.text: grāme vā nagare vāpi bhasmaprakṣepaṇena ca /
children.translated_text: In a village or in a city, by the casting of ashes /

children.text: ucchedanaṃ bhavaty eva ripūṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ // UT_2.26
children.translated_text: Uprooting of enemies certainly occurs — there is no doubt about this // UT_2.26

children.text: dūrīkṛtaṃ punar bhasma nagare vasate punaḥ /
children.translated_text: When the ashes are removed, [the person] dwells in the city again /

children.text: kulvīkāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yogaṃ samāsataḥ // UT_2.27
children.translated_text: I shall describe the <s>kulvīkāra</s> (transformation into an impotent one); hear the practice in brief // UT_2.27

children.text: yena yojitamātreṇa punaḥ kulvo bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: By the mere application of which, [the person] will become impotent /

children.text: pādapāṃśusamāyuktair antarā ghṛtagomayaiḥ // UT_2.28
children.translated_text: With dust from the feet [of the target], mixed together with ghee and cow dung // UT_2.28

children.text: vṛṣabhasya punaḥ śatroḥ kṛtvā caivākṛtiṃ budhaḥ /
children.translated_text: The wise one should make a figure of the enemy in the form of a bull /

children.text: ekaviṃśativāraṃ hi mantreṇānena mantritām // UT_2.29
children.translated_text: Consecrated twenty-one times with this <s>mantra</s> // UT_2.29

children.text: chedayet tīvraśastreṇa tataḥ kulvo bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: He should cut it with a sharp weapon; then [the target] will become impotent /

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate uḍḍāmareśvarāya kāmaprabhañjanāya amukaṃ cchaḥ cchaḥ svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>, the destroyer of desire! [Let] so-and-so, <s>cchaḥ cchaḥ svāhā</s>! /

children.text: prasthitānāṃ ca karaṇe mantreṇānena mantravit // UT_2.30
children.translated_text: For the procedure upon those who have set out, the knower of <s>mantras</s> [uses] this <s>mantra</s> // UT_2.30

children.text: kṛtvā madhu ghṛtāktaṃ ca sthāne hy atra prayojayet /
children.translated_text: Having made [the preparation] anointed with honey and ghee, one should employ it in the [proper] place /

children.text: snātvā ca gavyadugdhena tataḥ svastho bhaviṣyati // UT_2.31
children.translated_text: Having bathed with cow's milk, thereby [the patient] will become well // UT_2.31

children.text: atha unmattīkaraṇam /
children.translated_text: Now, the procedure for causing madness /

children.text: mūlaṃ kanakabījasya ghṛtacūrṇaṃ samantataḥ /
children.translated_text: The root of <s>kanaka</s> (thorn apple) seeds, powdered with ghee all around /

children.text: gṛhacaṭakasya viṣṭā ca tathā karañjabījakam // UT_2.32
children.translated_text: The droppings of a house sparrow, and also <s>karañja</s> (Indian beech) seeds // UT_2.32

children.text: etad unmattakaraṃ cūrṇaṃ bhakṣaṇāt tatkaraṃ vrajet /
children.translated_text: This madness-causing powder — by eating it, one falls into that state /

children.text: ekaviṃśativāraṃ ca mantreṇānena mantritam // UT_2.33
children.translated_text: Consecrated twenty-one times with this <s>mantra</s> // UT_2.33

children.text: khāne pāne pradātavyam unmattaḥ syān na saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: It should be administered in food or drink; [the person] will certainly become mad /

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate uḍḍāmareśvarāya amukam unmādaya unmādaya cchaḥ cchaḥ svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>! Drive so-and-so mad, drive mad! <s>Cchaḥ cchaḥ svāhā</s>! /

children.text: ajakṣīreṇa śoṇitena pibet tu śatapuṣpikām // UT_2.34
children.translated_text: One should drink <s>śatapuṣpikā</s> (dill) with goat's milk and blood // UT_2.34

children.text: ghṛtena saha vā pītvā tataḥ sampadyate sukham /
children.translated_text: Or having drunk it with ghee, thereby comfort is restored /

children.text: ity unmattīkaraṇam /
children.translated_text: Thus [ends] the procedure for causing madness /

children.text: ekaviṃśativāraṃ hi mantritaṃ lavaṇaṃ kharam // UT_2.35
children.translated_text: Salt, consecrated twenty-one times, harsh // UT_2.35

children.text: karavīrakakāṣṭhāgnau mantrair dhūmena pācayet /
children.translated_text: One should cook it in a fire of <s>karavīra</s> (oleander) wood, with smoke, using <s>mantras</s> /

children.text: lavaṇaṃ tantu saṃgṛhya cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ // UT_2.36
children.translated_text: Having collected that salt, the skillful one, having made it into a powder // UT_2.36

children.text: khāne pāne pradātavyaṃ mantreṇānena mantritam /
children.translated_text: It should be administered in food or drink, consecrated with this <s>mantra</s> /

children.text: mantritaṃ śatavāraṃ ca śatror vā yasya kasyacit // UT_2.37
children.translated_text: Consecrated a hundred times — of an enemy or of anyone whatsoever // UT_2.37

children.text: bhakṣaṇāc ca bhaved andho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
children.translated_text: By eating it, one becomes blind — there should be no doubt about this /

children.text: uoṃ nama uḍḍāmareśvarāya śarīram andhaṃ kuru ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>! Make the body blind! <s>Ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā</s>! /

children.text: athānyat sampravakṣyāmi kuṣṭhīkaraṇam uttamam // UT_2.38
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe another thing — the supreme procedure for causing leprosy // UT_2.38

children.text: yena sampītamātreṇa kuṣṭhī bhavati mānavaḥ /
children.translated_text: By the mere drinking of which, a person becomes a leper /

children.text: bhallātakarasaṃ guñjā tathā maṇḍalakārikā // UT_2.39
children.translated_text: <s>Bhallātaka</s> (marking nut) juice, <s>guñjā</s> (rosary pea), and <s>maṇḍalakārikā</s> (a type of lizard) // UT_2.39

children.text: gṛhagodhāsamāyuktā bhakṣe pāne pradāpayet /
children.translated_text: Combined with house-lizard [extract] — one should administer it in food or drink /

children.text: saptāhāj jāyate kuṣṭhaṃ tatpītaṃ ca samedhitam // UT_2.40
children.translated_text: Within seven days, leprosy arises; and what has been drunk becomes intensified // UT_2.40

children.text: etasya śamanaṃ kuryād yathā rudreṇa bhāṣitam /
children.translated_text: One should effect the cure of this as spoken by <s>Rudra</s> /

children.text: dhatrīkhadiranimbāni śarkarāsahitāni ca // UT_2.41
children.translated_text: <s>Dhātrī</s> (gooseberry), <s>khadira</s> (acacia), and <s>nimba</s> (neem), combined with sugar // UT_2.41

children.text: vicūrṇya madhusarpirbhyāṃ jīrṇāni dāpayed bhiṣak /
children.translated_text: Having powdered them, the physician should administer them with honey and ghee when digested /

children.text: śālibhaktaṃ paṭolaṃ ca ghṛtayuktaṃ tu pāyasam // UT_2.42
children.translated_text: Rice, <s>paṭola</s> (pointed gourd), and milk pudding with ghee // UT_2.42

children.text: soṣṇaṃ vā mudgacūrṇaṃ tu śāliyuktam athāpi vā /
children.translated_text: Or warm <s>mudga</s> (mung bean) powder combined with rice, or also /

children.text: etena dattamātreṇa naraḥ sampadyate sukham // UT_2.43
children.translated_text: By the mere administration of this, a person attains comfort // UT_2.43

children.text: jalajīvaṃ tu saṃgṛhya śoṣayed ātape naraḥ /
children.translated_text: Having collected a water-creature, a person should dry it in the sun /

children.text: tasya saṃdāpayed dhīmān yasya icchet tu jīvitam // UT_2.44
children.translated_text: The wise one should administer it to the person whose life one wishes [to save] // UT_2.44

children.text: aṅgadāhena tīvreṇa dhamet taṃ naṣṭacetasam /
children.translated_text: With intense burning of the limbs, one should blow upon that unconscious person /

children.text: yadīcchej jīvitaṃ tasya aṅgaṃ prakṣālayed dhruvam // UT_2.45
children.translated_text: If one desires the life of that person, one should certainly wash the limbs // UT_2.45

children.text: padamūlasya cūrṇaṃ tu kṣālayet kāñjikena tu /
children.translated_text: One should wash the powder of the foot-root with sour gruel /

children.text: tailenodvartayel liṅgaṃ kṣālayet śītavāriṇā // UT_2.46
children.translated_text: One should rub the body with oil and wash with cold water // UT_2.46

children.text: anena kriyamāṇena naraḥ sampadyate sukham /
children.translated_text: By performing this, a person attains comfort /

children.text: athānyat sampravakṣyāmi vaśyādikaraṇaṃ param // UT_2.47
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe another — the supreme procedure for <s>vaśīkaraṇa</s> (subjugation) and other [rites] // UT_2.47

children.text: yena vijñānamātreṇa loko bhavati kiṃkaraḥ /
children.translated_text: By the mere knowledge of which, the world becomes a servant /

children.text: purāṇikasya hṛdayaṃ tathā kuṣṭhena bhāvitam // UT_2.48
children.translated_text: The heart of a storyteller, infused with <s>kuṣṭha</s> (costus) // UT_2.48

children.text: śivanirmālyaṃ saṃcūrṇaṃ yasya mūrdhni vinikṣipet /
children.translated_text: The offering remnants of <s>Śiva</s>, powdered — one should cast it upon the head of [the target] /

children.text: niyataṃ kiṃkaro bhūtvā yāvaj jīvaṃ sa tiṣṭhati // UT_2.49
children.translated_text: Certainly becoming a servant, he remains so for as long as he lives // UT_2.49

children.text: saptavāraṃ mantrayitvā mantreṇānena mantravit /
children.translated_text: The knower of <s>mantras</s> should consecrate it seven times with this <s>mantra</s> /

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate uḍḍāmareśvarāya svādhikāraṃ sādhaya sādhaya svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>! Accomplish your authority, accomplish! <s>Svāhā</s>! /

children.text: candanaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ priyaṅgunāgakesaram // UT_2.50
children.translated_text: Sandalwood, <s>tagara</s> (valerian), <s>kuṣṭha</s> (costus), <s>priyaṅgu</s> (beauty-berry), and <s>nāgakesara</s> (cobra saffron) // UT_2.50

children.text: kṛṣṇadhattūrapañcāṅgaṃ samabhāgaṃ tu kārayet /
children.translated_text: The five parts of black <s>dhattūra</s> (thorn apple) should be made in equal portions /

children.text: chāyāyāṃ vaṭikā kāryā pradeyā khānapānataḥ // UT_2.51
children.translated_text: Pills should be made in the shade and administered through food and drink // UT_2.51

children.text: puruṣaṃ cātha vā narīṃ yāvaj jīvaṃ vaśaṃ nayet /
children.translated_text: Whether a man or a woman — one brings them under control for as long as they live /

children.text: saptāhaṃ mantritaṃ kṛtvā mantreṇānena mantravit // UT_2.52
children.translated_text: The knower of <s>mantras</s> should consecrate it for seven days with this <s>mantra</s> // UT_2.52

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate mohamāline ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Mohamālin</s> (garland of delusion)! <s>Ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā</s>! /

children.text: śaṅkhapuṣpī hy adhaḥpuṣpī tathā saṃkocapuṣpikā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkhapuṣpī</s> (butterfly pea), <s>adhaḥpuṣpī</s> (downward-flowering plant), and <s>saṃkocapuṣpikā</s> (sensitive plant) /

children.text: śvetā ca girikarṇī ca samaṃ saptāhabhāvitāḥ // UT_2.53
children.translated_text: White <s>girikarṇī</s> (glory lily), infused equally for seven days // UT_2.53

children.text: svaśukreṇa samāyuktā khāne pāne pradāpayet /
children.translated_text: Combined with one's own semen, it should be administered in food or drink /

children.text: taṃ vaśīkaraṇaṃ proktaṃ yāvaj jīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ // UT_2.54
children.translated_text: That is declared to be <s>vaśīkaraṇa</s> (subjugation) for life, without doubt // UT_2.54

children.text: vajraṃ vāthābhayā lodhraṃ mañjiṣṭhā hiṅgupattrikā /
children.translated_text: Thunderbolt [plant], or <s>abhayā</s> (chebulic myrobalan), <s>lodhra</s>, <s>mañjiṣṭhā</s> (Indian madder), <s>hiṅgu</s> (asafoetida), and leaves /

children.text: divyaṃ vacā viśālākṣā kambugrīvā suśobhanā // UT_2.55
children.translated_text: Divine <s>vacā</s> (sweet flag), <s>viśālākṣā</s> (wide-eyed plant), and the beautiful <s>kambugrīvā</s> (conch-necked plant) // UT_2.55

children.text: kumārītvacāṅgalepena saptahastapramāṇataḥ /
children.translated_text: With a body-paste of <s>kumārī</s> (aloe) bark, measuring seven hand-spans /

children.text: dadāti daśamīnā ca mantraḥ kaścit pragṛhyate // UT_2.56
children.translated_text: He gives [it] on the tenth day, and a certain <s>mantra</s> is taken up // UT_2.56

children.text: viṣasuptapatitvena nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
children.translated_text: Through the quality of being a husband stupefied by poison — there should be no doubt about this /

children.text: jalamadhye sahā cauraṃ kurute vartiko mama // UT_2.57
children.translated_text: In the midst of water, [the plant] <s>sahā</s> catches the thief; it makes a wick for me // UT_2.57

children.text: dadhi madhu navanītaṃ pippalī śṛṅgaveraṃ maricam api tu dadyāt saptamaṃ saindhavena /
children.translated_text: Curd, honey, fresh butter, long pepper, ginger, and also black pepper — one should give these seven with rock salt /

children.text: yadi bhavati saroṣaṃ takṣakeṇāpi daṣṭaṃ gadam iha khalu pītvā nirviṣaṃ tatkṣaṇaṃ syāt // UT_2.58
children.translated_text: If one is bitten even angrily by <s>Takṣaka</s> [the serpent king], having drunk this remedy here, one becomes poison-free at that very moment // UT_2.58

children.text: kuṣṭhāmṛtā cātiviṣā haridrāyā vilepanam /
children.translated_text: <s>Kuṣṭha</s> (costus), <s>amṛtā</s> (guduchi), <s>ativiṣā</s> (Indian atees), and turmeric as an ointment /

children.text: garuḍoktaṃ viṣaharam auṣadhaṃ prāṇijīvanam // UT_2.59
children.translated_text: This is the poison-removing medicine spoken by <s>Garuḍa</s>, which restores the life of living beings // UT_2.59

children.text: ulūkasya jambukasya gṛdhrasya mahiṣasya ca /
children.translated_text: The skins of an owl, a jackal, a vulture, a buffalo /

children.text: biḍālasya varāhasya kākabhekasya ca tvacaḥ // UT_2.60
children.translated_text: A cat, a boar, a crow, and a frog // UT_2.60

children.text: mūṣakasya tu netraṃ ca sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet /
children.translated_text: And the eye of a mouse — one should make fine powders [of these] /

children.text: anenāñjitanetro hi rātrau paśyed yathā divā // UT_2.61
children.translated_text: One whose eyes are anointed with this sees at night as if it were day // UT_2.61

children.text: eteṣāṃ yogamantro 'yaṃ manuhīno na sidhyati /
children.translated_text: This is the practice-<s>mantra</s> for these; without the <s>mantra</s>, it does not succeed /

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya śivāya jyotiṣāṃ pataye dehi jyotīṃṣi mativīryakaraṇāya svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Rudra</s>, the auspicious one, lord of luminaries! Grant me luminous powers for the strengthening of intellect and energy! <s>Svāhā</s>! /

children.text: ekarātroṣito bhūtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ // UT_2.62
children.translated_text: Having fasted for one night, on the dark eighth [lunar day], with concentrated mind // UT_2.62

children.text: liṅgasampūjanaṃ kṛtvā jalaṃ caivābhimantrayet /
children.translated_text: Having worshipped the <s>liṅga</s>, one should consecrate water /

children.text: dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitvā śatam aṣṭottaraṃ japet // UT_2.63
children.translated_text: Standing in the southern direction, one should recite [the <s>mantra</s>] one hundred and eight times // UT_2.63

children.text: tataḥ sidhyanti mantrāṇi cāñjanāni samantataḥ /
children.translated_text: Then the <s>mantras</s> become effective, and the eye-ointments [become potent] all around /

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate uḍḍāmareśvarāya añjanamantrasiddhiṃ dehi me svāhā ity añjanādhikāraḥ /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>! Grant me the accomplishment of the eye-ointment <s>mantra</s>! <s>Svāhā</s>! Thus [ends] the section on eye-ointment /

children.text: atha piśācīkaraṇam /
children.translated_text: Now, the procedure for causing possession by <s>piśācas</s> (malevolent spirits) /

children.text: kanakasya ca bījāni priyaṅgu guggulas tathā // UT_2.64
children.translated_text: Seeds of <s>kanaka</s> (thorn apple), <s>priyaṅgu</s> (beauty-berry), and <s>guggula</s> (bdellium resin) // UT_2.64

children.text: ātmānaṃ dhūpayitvā tu yojayed rājasaṃsadi /
children.translated_text: Having fumigated oneself, one should employ [it] in a royal assembly /

children.text: yogam imaṃ samāghrāti sa vaśyo jāyate bhṛśam // UT_2.65
children.translated_text: Whoever smells this practice becomes intensely subjugated // UT_2.65

children.text: kanakasya tu bījāni śvetārkacandrakesaram /
children.translated_text: Seeds of <s>kanaka</s> (thorn apple), <s>nāgakesara</s> (cobra saffron) of white <s>arka</s> (calotropis) and moon [plant] /

children.text: kuṣṭhaṃ ca devadāruṃ ca sarvam ekīkṛtaṃ tathā // UT_2.66
children.translated_text: <s>Kuṣṭha</s> (costus) and <s>devadāru</s> (deodar cedar) — all combined together // UT_2.66

children.text: piṣṭvā tena liptagātro yogaśaktyā baliṣṭhayā /
children.translated_text: Having ground [them] and smeared the body with it, by the mighty power of <s>yoga</s> /

children.text: yatra yatra praviṣṭas tu tatra tatra jayī bhavet // UT_2.67
children.translated_text: Wherever one enters, there one becomes victorious // UT_2.67

children.text: Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra, Tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra</s>, Third Chapter

children.text: kākasya pakṣau saṃgṛhya sarpakañcukam eva ca /
children.translated_text: Having collected the wings of a crow and a serpent's sloughed skin /

children.text: śmaśānabhasmasaṃyuktaṃ śatror uccāṭanaṃ bhavet // UT_3.1
children.translated_text: Combined with cremation-ground ashes — the <s>uccāṭana</s> (banishment) of an enemy occurs // UT_3.1

children.text: ity uccāṭanādhikāraḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus [ends] the section on <s>uccāṭana</s> (banishment) /

children.text: bhūtavādaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā garuḍabhāṣitam /
children.translated_text: I shall describe the <s>bhūtavāda</s> (spirit-discourse) as spoken by <s>Garuḍa</s> /

children.text: yenaiva jñātamātreṇa śatravo yānti vaśyatām // UT_3.2
children.translated_text: By the mere knowledge of which, enemies come under subjugation // UT_3.2

children.text: śatruniryāsaṃ saṃgṛhya cūrṇaṃ sattvaṃ ca tasya vai /
children.translated_text: Having collected the exudate of [a plant named after] the enemy, making a powder and extracting its essence /

children.text: bhāvayet saptarātraṃ tu bhojanaiḥ saha dāpayet // UT_3.3
children.translated_text: One should infuse it for seven nights and administer it with food // UT_3.3

children.text: dattamātreṇa tenaiva piśācair gṛhyate tu saḥ /
children.translated_text: By the mere giving of that, [the person] is seized by <s>piśācas</s> (malevolent spirits) /

children.text: svasthīkāre pradātavyā jayā tu madhuyaṣṭikā // UT_3.4
children.translated_text: For restoring health, one should administer the victorious licorice // UT_3.4

children.text: niryāsaiḥ śālasambhūtair bījāni katakasya ca /
children.translated_text: With the exudates produced from <s>śāla</s> (sal tree), and the seeds of <s>kataka</s> (clearing nut) /

children.text: bhāvayet saptarātraṃ tu bhojanaiḥ saha dīyate // UT_3.5
children.translated_text: One should infuse for seven nights and administer with food // UT_3.5

children.text: tasya bhakṣaṇamātreṇa grahaiḥ saṃgṛhyate naraḥ /
children.translated_text: By the mere eating of that, a person is seized by <s>grahas</s> (possessing spirits) /

children.text: śarkarādugdhapānena svastho bhavati nānyathā // UT_3.6
children.translated_text: By drinking sugar and milk, one becomes well — not otherwise // UT_3.6

children.text: vāstukasya tu niryāsaṃ bījāni katakasya ca /
children.translated_text: The exudate of <s>vāstuka</s> (lamb's quarters), and the seeds of <s>kataka</s> (clearing nut) /

children.text: marditvā yātayāmābhyāṃ gṛhyate brahmarākṣasaiḥ // UT_3.7
children.translated_text: Having crushed them when they are stale, one is seized by <s>brahmarākṣasas</s> (Brahmin demons) // UT_3.7

children.text: śarkarādugdhapānena svastho bhavati nānyathā /
children.translated_text: By drinking sugar and milk, one becomes well — not otherwise /

children.text: kapikacchukaniryāsair mātuluṅgasya bījakam // UT_3.8
children.translated_text: With the exudates of <s>kapikacchu</s> (velvet bean), and the seeds of <s>mātuluṅga</s> (citron) // UT_3.8

children.text: bhāvayet saptarātraṃ tu bhakṣye pāne pradāpayet /
children.translated_text: One should infuse for seven nights and administer in food or drink /

children.text: uoṃ namo bhagavate uḍḍāmareśvarāya maheśvaro nāma svāhā /
children.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the Lord <s>Uḍḍāmareśvara</s>! The one named <s>Maheśvara</s>! <s>Svāhā</s>! /

children.text: āmalakyāś ca cūrṇena strīdugdhasahitena ca // UT_3.9
children.translated_text: With the powder of <s>āmalakī</s> (gooseberry), combined with woman's milk // UT_3.9

children.text: pāyayitvā viṣkṛtaṃ tu svāsthyaṃ saṃjāyate dhruvam /
children.translated_text: Having made [the person] drink, and having purged, health is certainly restored /

children.text: śarkarāpadmakiñjalkapadmakesarakalkakaiḥ // UT_3.10
children.translated_text: With powders of sugar, lotus filaments, and lotus-stamen paste // UT_3.10

children.text: cūrṇīkṛtais tac cūrṇaṃ tu dugdhena saha dāpayet /
children.translated_text: That powder, made into fine form, should be administered with milk /

children.text: tadā duṣṭagrahair muktaḥ svasthaś ca jāyate naraḥ // UT_3.11
children.translated_text: Then, freed from malevolent <s>grahas</s> (possessing spirits), the person becomes well // UT_3.11

children.text: Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra, Caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra</s>, Fourth Chapter

children.text: athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi bhūtavāde sudurlabham /
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe that which is extremely rare in the <s>bhūtavāda</s> (spirit-discourse) /

children.text: yena vijñānamātreṇa sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate // UT_4.1
children.translated_text: By the mere knowledge of which, all <s>siddhis</s> (supernatural powers) arise // UT_4.1

body.text:
uoṃ hrīṃ kālī kaṅkālī kila kila svāhā /
idaṃ mantraṃ pūrvaṃ sahasradaśakaṃ japet /
tataḥ sahasraṃ juhuyāt kaṅkālī varadā bhavati suvarṇamāṣacatuṣṭayaṃ pratyahaṃ dadāti /
atha sarvajanamukhastambhanam antaḥ uoṃ hrīṃ namo bhagavatī durvacatī kili vācābhañjanī sarvajanamukhastambhinī hrāṃ hrīṃ hraiṃ hrauṃ hraḥ svāhā /
anena mantreṇa bilvamaricaṃ ghṛtāktaṃ sahasrahavanaṃ kuryāt samastajanapadāḥ kiṃkarā bhavanti /
etanmantreṇa yadi nyagrodhasamidhaṃ ghṛtāktāṃ sahasraikaṃ homayet tadā strīvaśyaṃ bhavati /

children.text: uoṃ rauṃ hrīṃ hūṃ hūṃ eṃ vada vada vāgvādinī vāgīśvarī namaḥ svāhā /
children.translated_text: 'Oṃ rauṃ hrīṃ hūṃ hūṃ eṃ, speak, speak, O goddess of speech, O <s>Vāgīśvarī</s> (mistress of speech), salutations, svāhā.'

children.text: anena mantreṇa sahasrajaptena kavitvaṃ karoti nātra saṃdehaḥ /
children.translated_text: By reciting this <s>mantra</s> one thousand times, it bestows poetic ability—there is no doubt in this.

children.text: uoṃ uoṃ uoṃ īṃ īṃ īṃ aiṃ aiṃ aiṃ namaḥ svāhā /
children.translated_text: 'Oṃ oṃ oṃ īṃ īṃ īṃ aiṃ aiṃ aiṃ namaḥ svāhā.'

children.text: anena mantreṇa daśasahasrajaptena kavitvaṃ karoti // UT_4.2
children.translated_text: By reciting this <s>mantra</s> ten thousand times, it bestows poetic ability. // UT_4.2

body.translated_text: 'Oṃ hrīṃ <s>Kālī</s> <s>Kaṅkālī</s> kili kili svāhā.' One should recite this <s>mantra</s> ten thousand times first. Then one should offer one thousand oblations; [then] <s>Kaṅkālī</s> becomes the bestower of boons and gives four <s>māṣas</s> (gold coins) of gold daily. Now, for the immobilization of the mouths of all people: 'Oṃ hrīṃ, salutations to the blessed <s>Durvacatī</s>, kili, O breaker of speech, O immobilizer of the mouths of all people, hrāṃ hrīṃ hraiṃ hrauṃ hraḥ svāhā.' With this <s>mantra</s>, one should make a thousand oblations of <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple) and pepper smeared with ghee; all the inhabitants of the region become servants. If with this <s>mantra</s> one offers a thousand oblations of <s>nyagrodha</s> (banyan) wood smeared with ghee, then it brings women under one's control.

children.text: Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra, Pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra</s>, Fifth Chapter.

children.text: śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi yathā trailokyamohanam /
children.translated_text: Listen, O son, I shall now declare the enchantment of the three worlds;

children.text: parapuruṣā vaśaṃ yānti yathāvat kathayāmi te // UT_5.1
children.translated_text: I shall tell you exactly how other men come under one's control. // UT_5.1

children.text: elā kuṣṭhaṃ ca lodhraṃ ca vacā ca raktacandanam /
children.translated_text: <s>Elā</s> (cardamom), <s>kuṣṭha</s> (costus), <s>lodhra</s> (symplocos), <s>vacā</s> (sweet flag), and red sandalwood,

children.text: śmaśānabhasmasaṃyuktaṃ prayogaṃ māraṇāntakam // UT_5.2
children.translated_text: combined with cremation-ground ash—this is the application leading to destruction. // UT_5.2

children.text: māraṇaṃ saṃkocakaraṇam /
children.translated_text: Destruction [means] causing contraction.

children.text: kulatthaṃ bilvapattraṃ ca rocanā ca manaḥśilā /
children.translated_text: <s>Kulattha</s> (horse gram), <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple) leaves, <s>gorocanā</s> (yellow pigment), and <s>manaḥśilā</s> (realgar)—

children.text: etāni samabhāgāni sthāpayet tāmrabhājane // UT_5.3
children.translated_text: these in equal parts should be placed in a copper vessel. // UT_5.3

children.text: saptarātre sthite pātre tailam ebhiḥ paced budhaḥ /
children.translated_text: After the vessel has stood for seven nights, the wise one should cook oil with these;

children.text: tailena bhagam ālipya bhartāram upagacchati // UT_5.4
children.translated_text: anointing the vulva with the oil, she goes to her husband. // UT_5.4

children.text: samprāpya maithunaṃ bhartā dāso bhavati nānyathā /
children.translated_text: Having obtained union, the husband becomes a servant, not otherwise. The wise one should make a pill combined with <s>nāgara</s> (dried ginger) and honey. // UT_5.5

children.text: nāgaraiḥ madhusaṃyuktair guṭikāṃ kārayed budhaḥ // UT_5.5
children.translated_text: Combined with mare's urine, it brings men under control.

children.text: aśvamūtreṇa saṃyujya puruṣāṇāṃ vaśaṃkaram /
children.translated_text: <s>Kuṅkuma</s> (saffron), <s>śatapuṣpa</s> (dill), <s>priyaṅgu</s> (beauty-berry), and <s>rocanā</s> (yellow pigment)—// UT_5.6

children.text: kuṅkumaṃ śatapuṣpaṃ ca priyaṅgu rocanaṃ tataḥ // UT_5.6
children.translated_text: these should be given with goat's milk to a wife who is unfortunate;

children.text: ajākṣīreṇa dātavyaṃ yā bhāryā durbhagā bhavet /
children.translated_text: // UT_5.6 cont.

children.text: tataḥ sā subhagā nityaṃ patidāsatvam āpnuyāt // UT_5.7
children.translated_text: then she becomes perpetually fortunate and her husband attains servitude to her. // UT_5.7

children.text: mātuluṅgasya bījāni paṅkajasya phalāni ca /
children.translated_text: Seeds of <s>mātuluṅga</s> (citron) and fruits of the lotus,

children.text: samudrajaṃ raktacūrṇaṃ madhunā saha lepayet // UT_5.8
children.translated_text: with ocean-born red powder, one should anoint with honey. // UT_5.8

children.text: tailayojitamātreṇa patir dāso bhaved dhruvam /
children.translated_text: By merely applying with oil, the husband surely becomes a servant. Now I shall declare the supreme essence of practices. // UT_5.9

children.text: adhunā sampravakṣyāmi yogānāṃ sāram uttamam // UT_5.9
children.translated_text: By merely knowing which, a woman becomes a servant.

children.text: yena vijñātamātreṇa narī bhavati kiṃkarī /
children.translated_text: <s>Uśīra</s> (vetiver) and sandalwood combined with honey— // UT_5.10

children.text: uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva madhunā saha saṃyutam // UT_5.10
children.translated_text: this is the application [called] 'elephant-trunk,' effective on all women.

children.text: gajahastaprayogo 'yaṃ sarvanarīprayojakaḥ /
children.translated_text: One should anoint the vulva with saffron combined with moonstone alone. // UT_5.11

children.text: kevalaṃ śaśinā yuktaṃ kuṅkumaṃ lepayed bhage // UT_5.11
children.translated_text: It becomes like one's own body; there arises accumulation in the womb.

children.text: nijavaj jāyate sāṅgaṃ jāyate yonisaṃcayam /
children.translated_text: <s>Lavaṅga</s> (clove), rock salt, honey, long pepper, and black pepper— // UT_5.12

children.text: lavaṃgaṃ saindhavaṃ kṣaudraṃ pippalī maricāni ca // UT_5.12
children.translated_text: one should anoint a man's body [with these]; he becomes like one with an elephant's trunk.

children.text: narasya lepayed gātraṃ sa bhaved gajahastavat /
children.translated_text: One should grind wasp-nest with cold water. // UT_5.13

children.text: varaṭāveśmasambānaṃ śītatoyena peṣayet // UT_5.13
children.translated_text: By merely anointing the vulva with that, no looseness arises;

children.text: tenaiva liptamātreṇa bhage randhro na jāyate /
children.translated_text: then by washing with that [water], fertility will result. // UT_5.14

children.text: tatra prakṣālitenātha prasavatvaṃ bhaviṣyati // UT_5.14
children.translated_text: // UT_5.14 cont.

children.text: yaḥ svaretaḥ samādāya ratyante savyapāṇinā /
children.translated_text: He who takes his own semen after intercourse with the left hand

children.text: vāmapādaṃ striyo limpet sā tasya vaśagā bhavet // UT_5.15
children.translated_text: and anoints the left foot of the woman—she comes under his control. // UT_5.15

children.text: yā bhogaśeṣe kāntasya liṅgaṃ vāmāṅghriṇā spṛśet /
children.translated_text: A woman who at the end of enjoyment touches the husband's member with her left foot—

children.text: yāvad āyur bhaved dāsaḥ sa tasyā nātra saṃśayaḥ // UT_5.16
children.translated_text: for as long as she lives, he becomes her servant, there is no doubt. // UT_5.16

children.text: kapotaviṣṭhā sindhūtthamadhukaiḥ samabhāgikaiḥ /
children.translated_text: With pigeon droppings, ocean-born [salt], and honey in equal parts,

children.text: liptvā liṅgaṃ bhajed yāṃ tu sā vaśyā syād varāṅganā // UT_5.17
children.translated_text: having anointed the member and enjoyed whichever woman—she becomes controlled, that excellent woman. // UT_5.17

children.text: ghanasāraṃ satallavyaṃ meḍhraṃ ca madhunā saha /
children.translated_text: Camphor, mixed with <s>tallavya</s>, the member, and honey—

children.text: piṣṭvā liptvā rajo yāṃ ca bhajet sā vaśyagā bhavet // UT_5.18
children.translated_text: having ground and anointed, whichever woman he enjoys—she comes under control. // UT_5.18

children.text: rocanā kanakaṃ śambhubījaṃ karpūracandanam /
children.translated_text: <s>Gorocanā</s> (yellow pigment), gold, <s>Śambhu's</s> (Śiva's) seed, camphor, and sandalwood—

children.text: ebhir viliptaliṅgo yāṃ bhajate sā vaśā bhavet // UT_5.19
children.translated_text: he whose member is anointed with these, whichever woman he enjoys—she becomes submissive. // UT_5.19

body.text:
Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra, ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ
kṛṣṇacchāgaromakṛṣṇamārjāraromakṛṣṇakākaromāṇi kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ vā śanibhaumayor vāre 'śleṣānakṣatre ārdrānakṣatre vā samabhāgāni kṛtvā kūpataḍāganadīpayasā peṣayitvā guṭikāṃ kṛtvā saṃgrāme copaviśet /
raṇapāṃśunā tilakaṃ kuryāt /

children.text: athānantaraṃ ye 'nye puruṣā darśanaṃ kurvanti te kampayanti mūrchayanti utpatanti palāyante /
children.translated_text: Thereupon, other men who come into view tremble, faint, jump up, and flee.

children.text: ye piṣṭvā lepaṃ kurvanti teṣāṃ śuci kāpi patati na muñcati /
children.translated_text: Those who grind [the ingredients] and make an ointment—nothing impure falls upon them or touches them.

children.text: eṣa yogo mayā prokto devānām api durlabhaḥ /
children.translated_text: This practice has been declared by me, difficult to obtain even for the gods.

children.text: nivedanīyaḥ kasyāpi na kadācid iti bruve // UT_6.1
children.translated_text: I say it should never be revealed to anyone. // UT_6.1

children.text: athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi śarīrajñānam uttamam /
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare the supreme knowledge of the body,

children.text: yena vijñānamātreṇa jāyate ca śubhāśubham // UT_6.2
children.translated_text: by merely knowing which, auspicious and inauspicious [events] arise. // UT_6.2

children.text: jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva lābhālābhaṃ jayājayam /
children.translated_text: Life and death, gain and loss, victory and defeat,

children.text: sukhaduḥkhaṃ bhavābhāvau gamanāgamanaṃ tathā // UT_6.3
children.translated_text: happiness and sorrow, existence and non-existence, coming and going likewise. // UT_6.3

children.text:
himālayasutā vai hi pṛṣṭavatī vṛṣadhvajam /
atha pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśāni tattvāni tatra guror bṛhatprasādena śāstrāṇi ca yena yogenātītena trailokyaṃ sacarācaraṃ jātam eva /
yeṣāṃ samayogāni sthūlasūkṣmāṇi kathyante /
sa ca sampretya ceṣṭāyāṃ lakṣyate tasyāḥ kiṃ nāma tasya ca kā jijñāsā yathāpad ucyate cāhus tataḥ pañcatattvāni paṭhyante /
samprati dūto yad āgatya vadati tasya vāg udeti pañcatattvākṣarāṇi jñātvā yasya tattvākṣarasya vaktre tattvākṣarāṇi bhavanti praśnacintāyāṃ sa tattvaṃ japati /
yadi praśnacintāyāṃ pṛthivītattvākṣarāṇi bhavanti tadā pṛthvītattvaṃ bhavati /
yady eṣām adhikā bhavanti tadā pānīyatattvāni bhavanti tattvākṣarāṇīty arthaḥ /
aāiīuūṛṝḷḹ etāni pṛthvītattvākṣarāṇi /
eaioauaṃaḥ etāni jalatattvākṣarāṇi /
kakhagaghaṅacachajajhaña etāni tejastattvākṣarāṇi /
ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇatathadadhanapaphababhama etāni vāyutattvākṣarāṇi /
yaralavaśaṣasaha tāny ākāśatattvākṣarāṇi /
etāni vardhitavākyenādhikākṣarāṇi bhavanti /
vividhaprakāracintāḥ samaviṣamākṣarāṇi pṛthvītattvāni jñātavyānīti /
jīvitamaraṇalābhālābhajayaparājayasukhaduḥkhagamanāgamanāni ca yāni samāni viṣamāṇi aptattvāni nirvācitavyāni /
yadā cittaṃ bhavati kṛtasya vākyaviṣaye pṛthivīviṣaye tadā salilatattvākṣarāṇi bhavanti tadā sa japtaṃ japati /
apcintāyāṃ yadā pṛthivītattvākṣarāṇi bhavanti tadā pṛthvītattvaṃ bhavati /
evam anyeṣv api boddhavyam /
children.translated_text: The daughter of the <s>Himālaya</s> (<s>Pārvatī</s>) indeed questioned <s>Vṛṣadhvaja</s> (<s>Śiva</s>, the bull-bannered one). Now, earth, water, fire, wind, and space are the <s>tattvas</s> (elements). By the great grace of the guru, through the scriptures, and by which practice in the past, the three worlds with all moving and non-moving beings have come into existence. Their combinations, gross and subtle, are described. And he, through the signs of actions [of the dying/departed], is observed—what is the name of that [element]? And what is the inquiry about it? As the difficulty arises, the five <s>tattvas</s> are recited. Now, when a messenger comes and speaks, his speech arises—knowing the syllables of the five <s>tattvas</s>, in whose mouth the <s>tattva</s>-syllables appear, in the inquiry of the question he recites that <s>tattva</s>. If in the inquiry of the question the earth-<s>tattva</s> syllables predominate, then it is the earth <s>tattva</s>. If these are more numerous, then the water-<s>tattva</s> syllables become [predominant]—this is the meaning. A ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ—these are the earth-<s>tattva</s> syllables. E ai o au aṃ aḥ—these are the water-<s>tattva</s> syllables. Ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña—these are the fire-<s>tattva</s> syllables. Ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma—these are the wind-<s>tattva</s> syllables. Ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha—those are the space-<s>tattva</s> syllables. These increase through extended speech with additional syllables. Various kinds of inquiries—even and uneven syllables are to be known as earth <s>tattvas</s>. Life, death, gain, loss, victory, defeat, happiness, sorrow, coming, and going—those that are even and uneven are the water <s>tattvas</s> to be declared. When the mind arises concerning the subject of the statement, in the earth domain, then the water-<s>tattva</s> syllables appear, and then one recites that [appropriate] recitation. In water-inquiry, when earth-<s>tattva</s> syllables appear, then it is the earth <s>tattva</s>. The same should be understood for the others as well.

children.text: akṣarāṇi yena kathayati /
children.translated_text: The syllables by which one speaks [are analyzed].

children.text: lābhacintāyāṃ tejākāśākṣarāṇi adhikāni bhavanti tadā te 'śubho 'dhikataro bhavitā /
children.translated_text: In inquiry about gain, if fire and space syllables are predominant, then the result will be more inauspicious.

children.text: yadā deśāt tattvād vā gamanādikaṃ tejasaḥ grāmacalite saṃgrāmagamane ahetu ake ḍake taijasākṣarāṇy adhikāni bhavanti /
children.translated_text: When from a region or <s>tattva</s>, movement etc. of fire—in the stirring of the village, in going to battle, without cause—the fire-<s>tattva</s> syllables predominate.

children.text: pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśā eteṣām akṣarāṇi vivāhakāle eteṣu tejo'kṣarāṇi śubhahārakāṇi bhavanti // UT_6.4
children.translated_text: Earth, water, fire, wind, and space—the syllables of these, at the time of marriage, among these the fire syllables are the bearers of auspiciousness. // UT_6.4

body.translated_text: <s>Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra</s>, Sixth Chapter. Hairs of a black goat, hairs of a black cat, and hairs of a black crow—on the dark eighth or dark fourteenth [of the lunar month], on Saturday or Tuesday, under <s>Āśleṣā</s> or <s>Ārdrā</s> <s>nakṣatra</s> (constellation)—having made [these] in equal parts and ground them with water from a well, tank, river, or lake, having made a pill, one should enter battle. One should make a <s>tilaka</s> (forehead mark) with the dust of the battlefield.

children.text: Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra, Saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra</s>, Seventh Chapter.

children.text: athauṣadhīkaraṇaṃ nirūpyate /
children.translated_text: Now the section on herbs is described.

children.text: oṣadhī paramā śreṣṭhā gopitavyā prayatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: The supreme and most excellent herb should be carefully concealed,

children.text: yasyāḥ prayogamātreṇa devatā yānti vaśyatām // UT_7.1
children.translated_text: by whose mere application even deities come under control. // UT_7.1

children.text: oṣadhī sā budhaiḥ proktā cāṇḍālī lokaviśrutā /
children.translated_text: That herb is called by the wise '<s>Cāṇḍālī</s>' (the outcaste woman), renowned in the world,

children.text: surāsuragaṇaiḥ pūjyā sarvakāryārthasādhinī // UT_7.2
children.translated_text: worshipped by hosts of gods and demons, accomplishing the purpose of all undertakings. // UT_7.2

children.text: ekapattrī dvipattrī ca tripattrī turyapattrikā /
children.translated_text: One-leafed, two-leafed, three-leafed, and four-leafed—

children.text: anena vidhinā devi catuścaraṇagāminī // UT_7.3
children.translated_text: by this method, O goddess, it moves in four ways. // UT_7.3

body.text:
mānuṣāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa vaśyakarmaṇi yojitā /
ekapattrī tu svāṅgamalasaṃyuktā striyaṃ vaśam ānayati dvipattrī rājño rājapuruṣān /
tripattrī śrīśākamaricasahitā duṣṭāṃ camūṃ vaśam ānayati catuṣpattrī ca kandusahitā mattaduṣṭagajaṃ vaśam ānayati /
athotpāṭanavidhiḥ kathyate śanivāre śucir bhūtvā sāyaṃ saṃdhyādikaṃ vidhāya gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyādibhiḥ pañcopacāraiḥ pūjādikaṃ vidhāya akṣataṃ phalaṃ haste gṛhītvā oṣadhisamīpe sthitvābhimantraṇaṃ kuryāt /
tato 'nudite bhānau khadirakāṣṭhakalikena khanayet /
tatra mantraḥ yena tvāṃ khanate brahmā hṛṣīkeśo maheśvaraḥ /

children.text: śacīpatiḥ pitṛpatir jaleśaś ca dhanādhipaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śacīpati</s> (Indra), the lord of the ancestors, the lord of waters, and the lord of wealth—

children.text: tena tvāṃ khanayiṣyāmi tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mahauṣadhi /
children.translated_text: by that I shall dig you up; stand, stand, O great herb!'

children.text: iti paṭhitvā khanayet /
children.translated_text: Having recited thus, one should dig.

children.text: śucir ārabhya ekānte prabhāte mantramuktitaḥ // UT_7.4
children.translated_text: Pure, beginning alone at dawn, with the utterance of the <s>mantra</s>. // UT_7.4

children.text: saṃgrāhyam auṣadhaṃ siddhyai na bhavanti hi kāṣṭhavat /
children.translated_text: The medicine should be collected for <s>siddhi</s> (supernatural attainment); [otherwise] they become like [mere] wood.

children.text: namo 'stv amṛtasambhūte balavīryavivardhini // UT_7.5
children.translated_text: Salutations to the one born of <s>amṛta</s> (nectar), O increaser of strength and vigor! // UT_7.5

children.text: balam āyuś ca me dehi pāpaṃ me naya dūrataḥ /
children.translated_text: Give me strength and life, and take my sins far away.

children.text: yena cānena mantreṇa khanitvotpāṭyamānaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ pūrvam ānīto yo 'nyathā bhavet /
children.translated_text: With this <s>mantra</s>, having dug and uprooted [the herb], that which was brought first—if it becomes otherwise [ineffective]:

children.text: atraiva tiṣṭha kalyāṇi mama kārśyakarī bhava // UT_7.6
children.translated_text: Stay right here, O auspicious one, become the remover of my emaciation. // UT_7.6

children.text:
mama kārye kṛte siddhe itas tvaṃ hi gamiṣyasi /
uoṃ hīṃ raktacāmuṇḍe hūṃ phaṭ svāhā /
anena mantreṇa puṣyarkṣe hastarkṣe vā nakṣatre sarvāś cauṣadhya utpāṭanīyā yair naraiś ca udite bhānau oṣadhyaḥ khanyante utpāṭyante utpadyante vā tāsāṃ ravikiraṇapītaprabhāvenāvīryaprabhāvo bhavati /
siddhikārikā na bhavanti /
